definitions.counts: Unique generated business request names per stage; event counts separate.
definitions.rsu_interest: No Interest RX collector exists. RSU upstream OUT proves forwarding, absence does not prove absence of reception.
definitions.data_rx: Saved network-face complete Data ingress; does not alone imply application satisfaction.
definitions.hello: Only OBU hello response DATA OUT observed after 20s; no per-hello input trace or MAC target in saved CSV.
definitions.radio: No MAC attempts, retry reasons, signal samples or airtime counters: loss mechanism not proven by L3 absence.
definitions.freshness: No observed OBU hello DATA response in preceding 2s; only requests >=22s used to avoid left censoring.
definitions.source_rsu: GENERATED.rsu_id; may be stale, is not proof of current coverage.
definitions.failures: Earliest unobserved stage for failed requests is descriptive, not a causal attribution.
